verdict.rationale: Groq explicitly documents drop-in OpenAI compatibility: just swap the api_key and base_url to api.groq.com/openai/v1 to use existing OpenAI client code (groq-docs-2, groq-docs-25), and states it's designed to be 'mostly compatible with OpenAI's client libraries' for easy switching (groq-docs-33). This directly supports mid-workflow provider switching without code rewrites, and is reinforced by SDK usage patterns in groq-typescript matching OpenAI's format (groq-gh-1, groq-gh-2). missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that switching mid-workflow (not just initial setup) is seamless, and clarification of what 'mostly compatible' excludes
